question: Should OpenClaw add an operator-controlled agent-level `systemPrompt`/`rules` config contract, and what edit authority, precedence, merge behavior, and session coverage should it have?
rationale: This would create a new public model-facing config surface for safety and behavior rules, so automation should not choose the trust boundary or permanent product semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve Scoped Append Contract
options.body: Add `agents.defaults` plus per-agent prompt/rules fields with append/merge semantics, operator-controlled mutation limits, docs, and cross-runner tests.

options.title: Keep Existing Surfaces
options.body: Reject a new core config field and document workspace bootstrap files, channel prompts, and plugin prompt hooks as the supported customization paths.

options.title: Split Include And Enforcement Work
options.body: Implement only the inline append contract here while leaving raw string includes to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82838 and hard gates to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13583.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Append Contract
recommendation.body: Add `agents.defaults` plus per-agent prompt/rules fields with append/merge semantics, operator-controlled mutation limits, docs, and cross-runner tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest recent history on the prompt/config boundary and the removed/owned system-prompt surface this decision would change.
